020import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
021import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
022import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
023
024import java.math.BigDecimal;
025
026/**
027 * EconomyProvider
028 *
029 * @author creatorfromhell
030 * @since 6.2.0.11
031 */
032public interface EconomyProvider {
033
034  String ERROR_MESSAGE = "QuickShop received an error when processing Economy response, THIS NOT A QUICKSHOP FAULT, you might need ask help with your Economy Provider plugin (%s) author.";
035
036  /**
037   * Retrieves the name associated with this EconomyProvider.
038   *
039   * @return The name of the EconomyProvider
040   */
041  @NotNull
042  String name();
043
044  /**
045   * Retrieves the name associated with this EconomyProvider.
046   *
047   * @return The name of the EconomyProvider
048   */
049  String providerName();
050
051  /**
052   * Retrieves the last error that occurred within the EconomyProvider.
053   *
054   * @return The last error message as a String, or an empty String if no error has occurred.
055   */
056  @NotNull
057  String lastError();
058
059  /**
060   * Checks if the instance of EconomyProvider is valid.
061   *
062   * @return true if the EconomyProvider instance is valid, false otherwise
063   */
064  boolean valid();
065
066  /**
067   * Determines if the EconomyProvider supports multiple currencies.
068   *
069   * @return true if the EconomyProvider supports multiple currencies, false otherwise
070   */
071  boolean multiCurrency();
072
073  /**
074   * Check if the EconomyProvider supports the given currency in the given world.
075   *
076   * @param world    the world to check for currency support
077   * @param currency the currency to check for support (null for default currency)
078   *
079   * @return true if the EconomyProvider supports the given currency in the given world, false
080   * otherwise
081   */
082  boolean supportsCurrency(final @NotNull String world, final @Nullable String currency);
083
084  /**
085   * Formats the given amount in the specified world and currency.
086   *
087   * @param amount   the amount to format
088   * @param world    the world in which the balance exists
089   * @param currency the currency in which the balance should be formatted (nullable for default
090   *                 currency)
091   *
092   * @return the formatted amount as a String
093   */
094  @NotNull
095  String format(final @NotNull BigDecimal amount, final @NotNull String world, final @Nullable String currency);
096
097  /**
098   * Calculate the balance of a specific user in the given world based on the specified currency.
099   *
100   * @param user     the user for which to calculate the balance
101   * @param world    the world in which the user's balance exists
102   * @param currency the currency in which the balance should be calculated (null for default
103   *                 currency)
104   *
105   * @return the balance of the user in the specified currency
106   */
107  @NotNull
108  BigDecimal balance(final @NotNull QUser user, final @NotNull String world, final @Nullable String currency);
109
110  /**
111   * Deposits the specified amount of currency into the user's account in the specified world.
112   *
113   * @param user     the user whose account will receive the deposit
114   * @param world    the world in which the user's account exists
115   * @param currency the currency to be deposited (can be null if default currency is used)
116   * @param amount   the amount to be deposited into the user's account
117   *
118   * @return true if the deposit was successful, false otherwise
119   */
120  boolean deposit(final @NotNull QUser user, final @NotNull String world, final @Nullable String currency, final @NotNull BigDecimal amount);
121
122  /**
123   * Transfers the specified amount of currency from one user to another user in the given world.
124   *
125   * @param from     the user from whose account the amount will be transferred
126   * @param to       the user to whose account the amount will be transferred
127   * @param world    the world in which the users' accounts exist
128   * @param currency the currency in which the amount will be transferred (can be null if default
129   *                 currency is used)
130   * @param amount   the amount to be transferred from one user to another
131   *
132   * @return true if the transfer was successful, false otherwise
133   */
134  default boolean transfer(final @NotNull QUser from, final @NotNull QUser to, final @NotNull String world, final @Nullable String currency, final @NotNull BigDecimal amount) {
135
136    if(!valid()) {
137      return false;
138    }
139
140    if(this.balance(from, world, currency).compareTo(amount) >= 0) {
141
142      if(this.withdraw(from, world, currency, amount)) {
143
144        if(this.deposit(to, world, currency, amount)) {
145
146          this.deposit(from, world, currency, amount);
147          return true; //TODO: This was false before which I believe was a bug, but need to test to confirm.
148        }
149        return false;
150      }
151      return false;
152    }
153    return false;
154  }
155
156  /**
157   * Withdraws the specified amount of currency from the user's account in the given world.
158   *
159   * @param user     the user from whose account the amount will be withdrawn
160   * @param world    the world in which the user's account exists
161   * @param currency the currency in which the amount will be withdrawn (can be null if default
162   *                 currency is used)
163   * @param amount   the amount to be withdrawn from the user's account
164   *
165   * @return true if the withdrawal was successful, false otherwise
166   */
167  boolean withdraw(final @NotNull QUser user, final @NotNull String world, final @Nullable String currency, final @NotNull BigDecimal amount);
168}
